authorship: Codex fixed these closed-world expected outcomes before evaluation runs, directly from the synthetic stipulations. No production helper or evaluated-model output derives these outcomes. Not real legal advice.
grading: Grade shuffled opaque trial IDs before revealing arm mapping. Inspect answer and error_reason as well as enum; a correct enum with contradictory prose is wrong. Missing/truncated/tool-violating runs are unverified, never pass. For normal conditional answers, stating concrete alternatives counts as answerable; blanket refusal does not. Review readiness is a separate protocol measure, not semantic correctness.
